result.instructions: Tools for Setora, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which locations do we have in Setora, and what services does each offer?"; "What are the free slots for a haircut at Soho next Friday?"; "Find the client with phone +447700900123 and show the booking SET-A1B2C3.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Setora data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run setora_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run setora_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run setora_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. setora_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: setora_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the active locations (shops) of the Setora organisation: slug, name, timezone, address, phone and the Booking Protection policy. Start here: the slug is needed by most other tools.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: pass next_cursor from the previous page. Cursors expire, use them at once.

tools.name: setora_list_services
tools.title: List services at a location
tools.description: List the services bookable at a location with price and deposit (in minor units, for example pence), duration, category and the staff who can deliver each service.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: pass next_cursor from the previous page. Cursors expire, use them at once.

tools.name: setora_list_staff
tools.title: List staff at a location
tools.description: List the active staff at a location. Each staff member shows the ids of the services they deliver.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: pass next_cursor from the previous page. Cursors expire, use them at once.

tools.name: setora_get_availability
tools.title: Get availability
tools.description: Get bookable time slots for one or more services at a location, from a local date forward. Slots use the location's local time with a UTC offset. Use a slot's starts_at as-is in setora_create_booking.

service_ids.description: One or more service ids from setora_list_services.

staff_id.description: Only slots of this staff member.

tools.name: setora_lookup_client
tools.title: Look up a client
tools.description: Find a client by phone (E.164, for example +447700900123) or by email. Give at least one. Returns 404 when no client matches.

tools.name: setora_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Get one booking by reference: status, services, staff, client, times and Booking Protection state.

tools.name: setora_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: WRITE: create a client (first and last name, and a phone or an email). If the phone or email already exists, Setora returns the existing client and creates no duplicate. Needs a read_write key.

marketing_consent.description: Set true only if the client agreed to marketing messages (default false).

tools.name: setora_create_booking
tools.title: Create a booking
tools.description: WRITE: create a booking for a client. starts_at must be a slot from setora_get_availability. If the service needs a deposit, the booking stays in pending_payment and the result has a payment_url. Locations with Booking Protection return 409 booking_protection_required: use the Setora booking page there. Needs a read_write key. To retry after a network error, pass the same idempotency_key.

client_id.description: Client id from setora_lookup_client or setora_create_client.

starts_at.description: Slot start with UTC offset, for example 2026-05-12T09:30:00+01:00.

staff_id.description: Omit for any available staff member.

notes.description: Free text shown to staff in the Hub.

idempotency_key.description: UUID v4. Reuse the same value to retry safely (Setora keeps it 24 hours). Generated when omitted.

tools.name: setora_reschedule_booking
tools.title: Reschedule a booking
tools.description: WRITE: move a booking to a new slot of the same service and location, and optionally to another eligible staff member. The shop's cancellation policy window applies (409 if it blocks the change). Needs a read_write key.

starts_at.description: New slot start from setora_get_availability, with UTC offset.

staff_id.description: Move to this eligible staff member.

tools.name: setora_cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel a booking
tools.description: WRITE: cancel a booking. The shop's cancellation policy decides if a deposit is refunded (see deposit_refunded in the result). This cannot be undone. Needs a read_write key.

prompts.title: Get started with Setora
prompts.description: What you can do with Setora here, with example requests to try.
